title: Screenshot a specific monitor on Wayland
summary: Capture only one specific display output and save it to a chosen file. Useful when you have multiple monitors.

steps.explain: Use the -o flag to specify the output name (e.g., DP-1, HDMI-1) and provide the path for the saved image.

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the display output (e.g., DP-1, HDMI-1).

placeholders.name: FILE_PATH
placeholders.description: The path where the screenshot will be saved.

steps.expect: A screenshot of the specified monitor is saved to the given file path.
